content.text:
I'm identifying the objects: a 4-square block, a vertical group, a 7-shape, a horizontal group, and then checking whether the bottom 4s at various diagonal positions count as separate objects under 4-connectivity, since diagonal touches wouldn't merge them.

So the final rule seems to be: keep all the 4s, but erase the 6, 7, and 3 objects.
